resources.string: Start a live, talk about anything, and an AI audience reacts to what you actually say.
%1$s is a simulation. Viewers, comments, gifts and followers are generated in the app. Your camera stays on your device and is never broadcast.
Go live with your camera and just speak. Stories, jokes, a question for the room.
Your phone turns speech into text. The AI audience reads what you mean, not your voice.
Comments, questions, gifts and viewer spikes follow the moment, then a recap when you end.
No real people watch. Viewers, comments, gifts and followers are made by %1$s.

Video is shown only to you. It's never recorded, uploaded or broadcast.
Raw audio is never stored. When the cloud audience is on, short bits of text go to our server, nowhere else.
Fame levels and counts live inside the app. They aren't real reach, and we never post for you.
Sign in with Google to keep your profile and lives safe across devices. A new account is created the first time.
